gloss: stepchild, child from a previous marriage

definitions.gloss: stepchild, child from a previous marriage
definitions.explanation: A child that one's spouse brings into a new marriage from a previous relationship.

examples.english: She has a child from a previous marriage.

examples.japanese: {連|つ}れ{子|こ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}している→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: I love my stepchild just the same as my own child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{再婚|さいこん}する→再婚する：25476_saikonsuru⟧{時|とき}、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つ}れ{子|こ}がいた。
examples.english: When we remarried, we each had children from previous marriages.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ (to bring along) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) - literally 'a child brought along.'

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{継子|ままこ}→継子：20695_mamako⟧: stepchild (alternative term, sometimes with negative connotations as in fairytales)
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: stepchild (more formal)
- ⟦{再婚|さいこん}→再婚：22805_saikon⟧: remarriage

USAGE:
{連|つ}れ{子|こ} is a neutral, commonly used term in modern Japanese for discussing blended families.
